summary: Nomura Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, reporting two routine items: the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, and the announcement of annual appointments of directors and executive officers made at the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and a Board of Directors meeting held on the same date. All appointments are reappointments, with no forced or abrupt management changes. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender offer, deal termination, or SPAC-related event.
